verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents its own audit arm as part of the product: a HITRUST Accredited Assessor, third-party assessment delivered alongside HIPAA readiness, a 'reliable audit partner' for PCI, and auditors working in the platform 'from kickoff to final report'. However, the pack never describes how a founder books or purchases the audit, and gives no published timeline expectations beyond vague claims of 'accelerating audit cycle times'. missing for 10: documented audit booking/engagement flow, published audit timeline expectations (e.g., weeks to report), independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-house audit experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline

citations.quote: Thoropass combines readiness, automation, and assessment in one connected experience, with a HITRUST Accredited Assessor and AI-powered Audit Lifecycle Platform guiding you from scoping through validation
Thoropass brings HIPAA readiness, evidence collection, and third-party assessment together in one connected experience
From scoping through final report, every step happens in one platform, so you spend less time managing the audit and more time strengthening your security program.
Thoropass connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report.
You can have it all, from expert guidance to user-friendly PCI DSS compliance automation software, certified ASV scans, pentesting, and a reliable audit partner.
